text: Figure 5.15: ImplementationDataType overview [TPS_SWCT_01252] ImplementationDataType can express concepts not avail- able on application level ⌈As a consequence of the specific focus, it is possible to express concepts with an ImplementationDataType that are not supported on the application level, i.e. by ApplicationDataType: • ImplementationDataType supports the definition of pointers • It is possible to define “alias” names just as in a typedef • It is possible to define nested ImplementationDataTypes but in contrast to the concept implemented for ApplicationDataType these implement a direct aggregation of sub-elements rather than applying the type-prototype pattern. ⌋(RS_SWCT_03217) emplate
